Loading campus…Reading model data

A campus, at your fingertips

  • Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, and right-drag to pan. On a touch screen, use one finger to orbit and two to zoom or pan.
  • Select a building in the model or list to inspect dimensions and sources. Each building can be hidden independently.
  • Explore architectural highlights, toggle exterior details, or use the height slice to compare volumes. Slices show exterior surfaces and are not interior floor plans.

The model, rendering engine and preview are embedded in this HTML. Open it directly in a browser without an internet connection. WebGL 2 is required for interaction.

Scale: 1 unit = 1 meter. Footprints are georeferenced public map data. Selected landmark heights come from published university or project sources. Historical municipal heights are estimates. Other heights, roofs, facade openings and tree shapes are approximate. Roads and outdoor surfaces follow mapped areas. Ground follows sampled USGS 3DEP terrain with simplified building pads; model Z = 0 corresponds to 225 m in the DEM datum. This is an independently made exterior study model, not an official BIM or a certified survey.

English is the default; devices with Chinese in their language preferences open in Chinese. A manual language choice is remembered when browser storage is available. Chinese building names are independent translations; English proper names remain available for comparison with the official map.

Sources: University map · University architecture · USGS terrain.
